ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.10 responds to repeated V0.4.8 captures showing JobGiver spikes dominated by GenClosest, Reachability.CanReach and RegionTraverser. A new fail-closed single-call candidate partition reorders supported custom global Work search candidates into stable nearest-first spatial rings during the current GenClosest call, so Vanilla can establish a close best-distance earlier and avoid unnecessary expensive reachability/validator checks on far candidates. Candidate membership is unchanged. Reachability, WorkGiver validators, reservations and final Jobs remain main-thread authoritative. Very large primitive position snapshots may use a bounded worker assist; no live Verse state is read by the worker. V0.4.8 slow JobPackage tracing, V0.4.7/V0.4.6 hauling fast paths, bounded path shadow validation and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained.
